definitions.explanation: the central part of a flower, including the pistil and stamens

examples.japanese: {花芯|かしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{蜂|はち}→蜂：02242_hachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まっている→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: A bee is resting on the center of the flower.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花芯|かしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{色|いろ}づいて→色づく：10074_irozuku⟧きた。
examples.english: The centers of the cherry blossoms have begun to turn red.

examples.japanese: マクロ⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}する→撮影する：21990_satsueisuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{花芯|かしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{繊細|せんさい}→繊細：07607_sensai⟧な⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: When photographing with a macro lens, you can clearly see the delicate structure of the flower's center.

notes:
Refers to the central reproductive part of a flower, encompassing the pistil (⟦{雌|め}しべ→雌しべ：29508_meshibe⟧) and stamens (⟦{雄|お}しべ→雄しべ：29501_oshibe⟧). Used in botany, gardening, flower arrangement (⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧), and photography contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花芯|かしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: color of the flower center
- {花芯|かしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: the flower center opens
- {花芯|かしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧: to touch the flower center

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{雌|め}しべ→雌しべ：29508_meshibe⟧: pistil — the female reproductive part specifically
- ⟦{雄|お}しべ→雄しべ：29501_oshibe⟧: stamen — the male reproductive part specifically
- ⟦{花弁|かべん}→花弁：04369_kaben⟧: petal — the outer colorful parts surrounding the center
- {花蕊|かずい}: flower stamen — a more technical botanical term
